A separate particle has velocity u=+0.6 in S. Return answer keys gamma, delta_t_prime, delta_x_prime, interval_t2_minus_x2, particle_velocity_prime, separation_type (timelike/spacelike/null), reversed_order (boolean), simultaneous_frame_velocity. Give numeric values, not expressions. Distinguish the event-pair displacement from the separate particle velocity.
